businesses.business: consumer credit underwriting and funding platform

offering_description.value: Pagaya helps banks, credit unions and fintech lenders evaluate and fund personal, auto and retail installment loans. It integrates machine-learning underwriting into lenders’ application systems and connects qualifying loans with institutional investors through securitizations and other funding arrangements.

primary_products.value: Consumer loan-backed securities issued through sponsored vehicles

primary_services.value: Credit assessment and underwriting support; loan funding arrangements; securitization structuring and management

customer_segment.value: B2B: Banks, credit unions, fintech lenders, auto finance companies, retail financing providers and institutional credit investors

end_markets.value: Personal lending; automotive finance; retail installment finance; institutional structured credit

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Network fees tied to the volume of loans funded through the platform; commissions or management fees: Management of investment vehicles that buy consumer loans
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Analyzes lender application data and returns credit assessments within partner lending systems; financial intermediary: Connects loans originated by partner lenders with institutional investors through securitizations and other funding arrangements

geography_served.value: US national: U.S. consumer lending market, with technology operations in Israel

specialization.value: related lines: Personal, auto and retail installment loan underwriting and funding, plus structured credit for institutional investors

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Business development teams working with lender partners and institutional investors; partners / resellers: Embedded integrations in bank, fintech and other lending partners’ application systems

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Investment advisory registration and securities offering rules, with fair lending and consumer data requirements for credit assessment

notes: The current scope of any remaining single-family rental activities is uncertain.
